lines.en: My four feet land and loosen the soil.
I plod across the open ground.
A herd follows behind me.
I stretch my neck for the leaves.
The herd moves toward the river.
I snap a dry branch underfoot.
My tail balances my weight.
The Cretaceous plains are wide.
I lower my head, then lift it again.
My feet sink into the soft mud.
I slow the pace for the young ones.
My thick hide warms in the sun.
I walk around a fallen trunk.
Every step is steady.
I chew leaves without hurry.
The wind passes over my spine.
I raise my head toward a distant noise.
Someone in the herd is head-butting.
I blink once, slowly.
Grass sways at my mouth.
I stand like a mound of earth.
The leaves in this grove are good.
I flick my tail at the flies.
A low rumble rolls in my throat.
I count the members of my herd.
A hatchling hides by my legs.
I wait for the sun to sink.
No rush; the grass will not run.
You may stand there; I do not mind.
You are shorter than I am.
I lift my eyes to your hands.
There is no grass smell on you.
I turn aside to let you pass.
Do not stand by my feet.
I can tell you mean no harm.
If you touch me, do it slowly.
My eyes sit on either side of my head.
You back away; that eases me.
I recognise your voice now.
The whole herd is watching you.
You do not look like a predator.
I snort once, in answer.
My neck stands taller than you.
Come closer and let me smell you.
I bellow once, low.
Even my thick hide has been cut.
I take a step back and steady myself.
This hurts more than you would think.
The whole herd grows restless.
I shake my head to throw off the pain.
Do not come nearer.
I can still stand like this.
The young are calling; I must hold.
I will remember this one.
These leaves smell good.
Give me that bundle of grass.
I stretch my neck toward it.
I walk slowly after you.
Sweeter than fern.
I lick my lips.
The rest of the herd wants some too.
One more mouthful, then I go.
Raise the grass a little.

lines.zh: 为吃的,我可以跟你走很远
lines.en: For food, I would follow you far.
You hit my leg and bounce off.
I barely felt it.
Do not ram me from behind.
I shift half a step for you.

lines.zh: 我这条尾巴扫到你了吗
lines.en: Did my tail catch you?
We are crowded together.
You cannot move this bulk.
I lower myself toward you.
That tickled.
Mind your feet; do not get stepped on.
I rest my head gently against you.
We walk to the river together.
We watch the herd's young together.
You graze there; I graze here.
I make a very soft call.
Our shadows lie together.
This meadow can feed a herd.
I take the outer edge; you stay inside.
It is far; we walk together.
Beside you, I am at ease.
I lower my head and take the grass.
Can I swallow this grass?
I curl my tongue around it.
I carry it to the little one.
A bit tough, but I am not fussy.
I take the whole pile.
I chew so loudly the leaves rustle.
The leaves still carry dew.
Do not snatch; we share it.
I hold it and swallow slowly.
Who is standing there?
I lift my head and fix on you.
My herd is pulling back.
I plant myself before the young.
Your movements are too quick.
I give a low warning rumble.

lines.zh: 我身后的群已经压低脖子。
lines.en: The herd behind me has lowered their necks.
One more step and I will not be gentle.
I have seen your weapon.
My feet are set.

lines.zh: 后面的同类也叫起来了
lines.en: The herd behind me is calling too.
This is no longer grazing time.
I lower my neck to charge.
You chose the wrong opponent.
I follow the way you move.
Wherever you go, I block.
My feet paw the ground.
Come close and I will ram you.
I am watching your armour.
Do not circle to my flank.
I note every time you stop.
The herd closes around me.
I will not chase far; I only hold.
I have pawed a hollow in the dirt.
You retreat too fast and stumble.
My breathing has grown heavy.
I am holding this breath.
If you mean to fight, do it now.
The young ones are hidden.
My whole neck comes down.
This blow can topple a giant.
I shove you off your feet.
My foot stomps; the ground shakes.
My tail sweeps across.

lines.zh: 两只同类的重量压向你
lines.en: Two of my herd bear down on you.
Even a giganotosaur fears this.
I lower my head and bite the cloth.
You cannot retreat; the tree is behind you.
Never underestimate a grazer.

lines.zh: 我一直很温和,到此为止
lines.en: I have been gentle until now.
You forced this blow.
The ground cracks under me.
I bellow and keep pushing.
A long call; the herd has arrived.
I step out of the trees.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的草地又热闹了
lines.en: The Cretaceous meadow is busy again.

lines.zh: 一大群脚印出现在泥上
lines.en: A broad track of prints appears in the mud.
I raise my head and take in the land.
The hatchlings trail behind.
The grass flattens under my feet.
Grass enough, and water near.
We have come from far away.
I swing my tail once.
The herd spreads out to graze.
Feel the ground shaking?
I set my first foot down.
Everyone in the herd is here.
Big does not mean easy prey.
I am looking for the herd leader.
I sniff the fresh soil.
Another meadow has an owner.
My hide is scorching.
All four legs slam into the ground.
Water fills my nostrils; I choke.
Earth and blood erupt together.
Something sharp lodges in my flank.
My bones have gone cold.
My belly feels like stone.
Lightning runs down my spine.

lines.zh: 脚下一空,我找不到地面
lines.en: The ground is gone; I cannot find it.
